title: Sean Payton says he didn't know about the communication with Drew Brees

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton says he didn't know about the communication with Drew Brees
sources.description: On Monday night, a report emerged that multiple Broncos coaches had reached out to retired quarterback Drew Brees about the possibility of joining the Broncos for the AFC Championship after starter Bo Nix suffered a season-ending foot injury.
